data.name: Ashcharya
data.long_meaning: Ashcharya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ashcharya', which means 'wonder', 'surprise', or 'marvel'. It is often used to describe something that is remarkable or awe-inspiring. In Hindu mythology, Ashcharya is the name of a divine being who embodies this quality.

in_sanskrit.name: अष्चर्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
अष् (Aṣ) + चर्य (Carya) = अष्चर्य (Aṣcharya)
Aṣ (Aṣ) means without
Carya (Carya) means wonder, marvel, miracle.

in_hindi.name: अष्चर्य
in_hindi.meaning:
अष् (Aṣ) + चर्य (Carya) = अष्चर्य (Aṣcharya)
Aṣ (Aṣ) का मतलब है अपने
Carya (Carya) का मतलब है अधुरी, अतिगर्ह, अतिसंगी
So, Ashcharya means 'beyond wonder' or 'marvelous'.
